body.x: Engage selected VIP players through Telegram using a structured, priority-based approach. This SOP has three parts: the operational SOP, the engagement scripts, and the soft-skill playbook.
Telegram is a supplementary engagement channel. It does not replace Internal Mail or Livechat. Never promise, imply or hint at any bonus on Telegram.

x: Never promise, imply or hint at any bonus on Telegram.
Work strictly top down the priority order. Never approach a lower priority while higher-priority players are uncontacted.
One approach message per session. Wait for a reply before following up. Repeated messages get you blocked.
No VVIP or Priority Support language in Telegram drive content.
"Available" status is a last resort only, after all other approaches are exhausted. Ask the ATL.

head: Action
Sequence (when)
Degree / standard
Tool
rows: Open Customer Approaching File > Telegram section for the current month
Prior-month follow-ups: open the prior month's file
Review the priority list, identify the highest-priority players for this session
For a Livechat referral or Friendly Player, create a record tagged accordingly
First approach: create a New Approach record with date, username, brand, tier, reason
Follow-up: add a sub-record under the original entry
Verify the player has a registered Telegram contact before approaching
Send the approach message with the right tone for the segment
One message per session; wait for a reply before follow-up
Response Received, No Response, Deposit Made, or Referred to Livechat
If they respond via Livechat after Telegram, record a successful Livechat conversion and link the reference
Update the QA Record at end of shift

head: Scenario
CS Objective
rows: Get a reply, learn the reason for inactivity, fix one issue, record preferences.
Establish the relationship, get consent for contact style, capture preferences, set expectation that VIP CS is useful.
Welfare check. Support options, reduce pressure, protect the relationship. Not to drive activity.
White-glove care, reinforce trust, improve service, without pushing bigger deposits.

x: Newly Upgraded VVIP: soon after the 2:00 PM list update, in normal service hours.
Risk Player: same day the inactivity tier is first detected.
High-Loss Player: wait until at least the next day. Never message while emotions are high.
High Deposit / LTV: weekly, or scheduled relationship check-ins.
Understand the starting point. Promo-claim players think "no reason to stay". Shift that to "someone takes care of me here".
First touch: start a conversation, do not jump into another promo.
Branch on response. Won: celebrate, soft-guide. Lost: acknowledge, reframe, never "win it back". No response: soft re-engagement later, no spam.
Become a personal assistant: recommend games at their level, respond fast, remember preferences.
Introduce value slowly, not just bonuses.
Micro-engagement builds habit. Consistency beats intensity.
Tag and personalise: preferred games, win-loss reaction, activity timing, deposit behaviour.
Avoid: messaging only when there is a promo, copy-paste spam, pushing deposits early, ignoring replies.
The goal is not "get deposit". It is to make the player feel guided, valued and comfortable. Deposits follow.
Follow the priority order strictly; do not skip to a lower priority while higher ones are uncontacted.
One approach message per session; repeated messages get you blocked.
Never promise or hint at a bonus on Telegram.
Engagement scoring and the Kanban tracker are in the Telegram Engagement Tracker SOP.
"Available" status is a last resort only, after all other approaches are exhausted. Ask the ATL.
